title: Sample health policy

scenarios.question: Will a delivery bill be paid?
Is a private room paid in full?
How long before existing illnesses are covered?
Cover used up mid-year — what then?
Do you pay a share of every bill?

sections.title: Essentials
sections.subtitle: These decide how much of a hospital bill actually gets paid

items.label: Sum insured
items.why: The most the policy pays in a year. Big-city surgeries can cost ₹5–15 lakh.

items.label: Room rent
items.why: A room-rent cap can cut the payout for the whole bill, not just the room.
items.detail: Single private room, up to 1% of sum insured per day

items.label: Co-payment
items.why: A co-payment means you pay a share of every claim yourself.

items.label: Deductible
items.why: With a deductible, the first part of each claim is paid by you.

items.label: Pre-existing illness waiting
items.why: Illnesses you already had are covered only after this wait.

items.label: Before & after admission
items.why: Tests and medicines before and after a hospital stay.

items.label: Restoration of cover
items.why: Refills your sum insured if it runs out in the year.

items.label: No-claim bonus
items.why: Your cover grows for every claim-free year.
items.detail: 50% increase per claim-free year, up to 100%

items.label: Day-care treatment
items.why: Procedures that need less than 24 hours in hospital.

items.label: Modern treatments
items.why: Robotic surgery, immunotherapy and similar care.
items.detail: Covered up to 50% of sum insured

items.label: Specific illness waiting
items.why: Some illnesses (e.g. cataract, hernia) are covered only after a wait.

sections.title: Extras
sections.subtitle: Useful, but they rarely decide a big claim

items.label: Ambulance
items.why: Road ambulance to the hospital.

items.label: AYUSH treatment
items.why: Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy in hospital.

items.label: Doctor visits (OPD)
items.why: Consultations and tests without admission.

items.label: Treatment at home
items.why: Hospital-level treatment given at home.

items.label: Domiciliary care
items.why: Treatment at home when you can't be moved to a hospital.

sections.title: Depends on your plans
sections.subtitle: Matters for some families more than others

items.label: Maternity
items.why: Delivery and related expenses, usually after a waiting period.

items.label: Cosmetic or plastic surgery
items.why: Listed as an exclusion in your policy.

items.label: Self-inflicted injury
items.why: Listed as an exclusion in your policy.

items.label: Treatment outside India
items.why: Listed as an exclusion in your policy.
